Vendored net transport
======================

Socket.cpp/h, SocketErrors.h, TrustStore.cpp/h, Url.cpp/h and core/Platform.h
are copied unmodified from the Duskaryon_V3.1 project (Native/DuskaryonMedia/
vendor/net, revision of 2026-11), which in turn follows OpenOrbis'
net/Socket.cpp and HttpsClient.cpp patterns. They are the raw-socket and
BearSSL glue the PlayStation Store DNS bypass of src/network_bypass.cpp uses.

Upstream references:
  https://github.com/OpenOrbis/OpenOrbis-PS4-Toolchain (BSD-2-Clause)
  BearSSL, third_party/bearssl (MIT; see third_party/bearssl/LICENSE)

upstream.json records the SHA-256 of each copied file. The Socket.cpp entry
differs from Duskaryon's own record: that project's upstream.json is stale
relative to its working copy; the hash below is of the file actually copied,
verified byte-identical to the Duskaryon_V3.1 working tree.

No license text accompanies these files in Duskaryon's tree; they are covered
by the notices above and by the project's own license notices.
